request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Echojaw Lynx".

Creative brief
Name: Echojaw Lynx
Collection: Arcane Menagerie. Wild creatures altered by concentrated magic, with crystalline anatomy, runes, echoes, orbiting objects, and unusual projectile behavior.
Core concept: A stalking predator whose attacks repeat from phantom copies of its previous position.
Body and silhouette: Lean feline with long legs, large ear tufts, short tail, and a wide glowing jaw.
Signature features: Double-outline echo effect, rune-lined mouth, and floating ear-tip shards.
Palette and materials: Midnight blue, muted lavender, pale silver, and cyan light.
Movement personality: Quiet, prowling, and suddenly explosive.
Attack concept: Fires a narrow claw-shaped spread, relocates, and then an afterimage at its former position repeats the same spread.
Directional details: The right ear tuft splits into two prongs.
Avoid: Domestic cat, ghostly transparency obscuring the shape, realistic spotted fur.
